The applicable opening may require an in-year take-on, and mature monetary movement remains unresolved. The filing says all business is discontinued; the adopted whole-year run-off rule excludes only records outside the assumed-business regime. This year is in that regime from strong inward-RITC evidence, so the exception applies even if whole-year run-off is confirmed.
